```{python}
#| context: setup
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from itables import show, init_notebook_mode

init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False)

df = pd.read_parquet("outputs/clusters.parquet")
urban = df[df["zone"] == "urban"].copy()
bands = ["No risk", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Unfit"]
urban["band_i"] = urban["irca_band"].astype(str).map({b: i for i, b in enumerate(bands)})
years = sorted(urban["year"].unique())

geo = json.load(open("data/municipios.geojson"))

def reverse_rings(coords):
    # RFC 7946 exterior rings run counter-clockwise; Plotly expects the opposite.
    if isinstance(coords[0][0], (int, float)):
        return coords[::-1]
    return [reverse_rings(c) for c in coords]

def fix(geom):
    if geom["type"] == "Polygon":
        geom["coordinates"] = [r[::-1] for r in geom["coordinates"]]
    elif geom["type"] == "MultiPolygon":
        geom["coordinates"] = [[r[::-1] for r in poly] for poly in geom["coordinates"]]
    return geom

for f in geo["features"]:
    f["geometry"] = fix(f["geometry"])

# light-to-dark sequential colours for no risk -> unfit
colors = ["#fff7bc", "#fec44f", "#fe9929", "#d95f0e", "#7f2704"]
n = len(bands)
scale = []
for i, c in enumerate(colors):
    scale += [[i / n, c], [(i + 1) / n, c]]
```

# Map

## Row

### Column {width=70%}

```{python}
#| title: "IRCA band of urban zones by year (utility-supplied, INS open data)"
def trace(y):
    d = urban[urban["year"] == y]
    return d
d0 = trace(years[0])
fig = go.Figure(go.Choropleth(
    geojson=geo, featureidkey="properties.divipola",
    locations=d0["divipola"], z=d0["band_i"], zmin=-0.5, zmax=n - 0.5,
    colorscale=scale, marker_line_width=0.1, marker_line_color="#555",
    text=d0["municipio"] + ": " + d0["irca_band"].astype(str),
    hovertemplate="%{text}<extra></extra>",
    colorbar=dict(title="IRCA band", tickmode="array", tickvals=list(range(n)),
                  ticktext=bands, len=0.8, thickness=14),
))
fig.frames = [go.Frame(name=str(y), data=[go.Choropleth(
    locations=trace(y)["divipola"], z=trace(y)["band_i"],
    text=trace(y)["municipio"] + ": " + trace(y)["irca_band"].astype(str))]) for y in years]
fig.update_geos(fitbounds="locations", visible=False)
fig.update_layout(
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), height=520,
    sliders=[dict(active=0, currentvalue=dict(prefix="Year: "),
                  steps=[dict(method="animate", label=str(y),
                              args=[[str(y)], dict(mode="immediate", frame=dict(duration=0, redraw=True))])
                         for y in years])],
)
fig
```

# 🧬 Kinds

```{python}
#| context: setup
import plotly.express as px
prof = pd.read_csv("outputs/cluster_profiles.csv").set_index("cluster")
oy = pd.read_csv("outputs/outcomes_by_year.csv")
rho = pd.read_csv("outputs/irca_infant.csv").set_index("cluster")
ks = pd.read_csv("outputs/k_selection.csv")
cname = prof["name"]
ccolor = {cname[c]: prof.loc[c, "color"] for c in prof.index}
zc = [c for c in prof.columns if c.startswith("z_")]
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Mean z-score of each profile feature by cluster (within year; blue below, red above)"
Z = prof[zc].copy(); Z.columns = [c[2:] for c in zc]; Z.index = [cname[c] for c in Z.index]
fig = px.imshow(Z.T, color_continuous_scale="RdBu_r", zmin=-2, zmax=2, aspect="auto",
                text_auto=".1f", labels=dict(color="mean z"))
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), height=430)
fig.update_xaxes(tickfont_size=10)
fig
```

## Row

Clusters use profile features only (IRCA is utility-supplied, INS open data). Descriptive, not causal.

# 🎯 Outcomes

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Median infant mortality (deaths per 1,000 live births) by year and cluster"
def line(outcome, unit):
    d = oy[oy["outcome"] == outcome].copy()
    d["cluster_name"] = d["cluster"].map(cname)
    full = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([sorted(d["cluster_name"].unique()), range(2016, 2024)],
                                      names=["cluster_name", "year"])
    d = d.set_index(["cluster_name", "year"]).reindex(full).reset_index()  # gaps stay NaN
    fig = px.line(d, x="year", y="median", color="cluster_name", markers=True,
                  color_discrete_map=ccolor, labels=dict(median=unit, cluster_name="cluster"))
    fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), height=300, legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.3))
    return fig
line("infant_mortality", "per 1,000 live births")
```

```{python}
#| title: "Median Saber 11 global score (0-500) by year and cluster"
line("saber11_mean", "points (0-500)")
```

#| title: "Median school dropout rate (%) by year and cluster"

```{python}
#| title: "Spearman rho of IRCA vs infant mortality within each cluster"
r = rho.reset_index(); r["cluster"] = r["cluster"].map(cname)
fig = px.bar(r, x="cluster", y="spearman_rho", color="cluster", color_discrete_map=ccolor,
             text=r["spearman_rho"].round(2), labels=dict(spearman_rho="Spearman rho"))
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), height=300, showlegend=False)
fig
```

## Row

Descriptive, not causal: association within clusters is weak and says nothing about the effect of water quality.
Gaps are years a source does not cover; infant mortality changes method in 2017.

# 📐 Method

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Inertia by k (elbow)"
fig = px.line(ks, x="k", y="inertia", markers=True)
fig.add_vline(x=int(prof.shape[0]), line_dash="dot")
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), height=330)
fig
```

```{python}
#| title: "Mean silhouette by k"
fig = px.line(ks, x="k", y="silhouette", markers=True)
fig.add_vline(x=int(prof.shape[0]), line_dash="dot")
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0), height=330)
fig
```

## Row

k = 4 (dotted line): the 5th cluster cuts inertia by only about 7%, and the silhouette at k = 4
is within 0.01 of the best k >= 3. Clustering uses nine profile features, standardised within
year; outcomes only describe the clusters. All comparisons are descriptive, not causal.
